steps.title: Nina: repairable clothing catalogue · part 1
steps.detail: Nina is helping a customer repair a favourite jacket. A seam repair costs less than a replacement and the fabric is sound. What should the consultation offer?

choices.label: Explain the repair and show both real prices

steps.title: Nina: repairable clothing catalogue · part 2
steps.detail: A supplier calls Nina's fabric sustainable without a certificate. Nina wants an honest catalogue for her students. Which wording is safe?

choices.label: Describe the material and leave the claim unverified

steps.title: Nina: repairable clothing catalogue · part 3
steps.detail: Nina refers a clothing workshop that wants a repair catalogue. They ask you to promise every garment can be repaired. What scope can you agree to?

choices.label: Document repairable examples and inspection limits

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented repairable clothing catalogue. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Nina.
